parsed.explanation: If outed, a trans visitor faces catastrophic severity: modesty/immorality laws reach public presentation, the 1994 code prescribes flogging and imprisonment for same-sex conduct, and armed-faction courts in 2024 imposed death by stoning and crucifixion on more than 40 people for homosexuality/immorality. Enforcement is uneven and rarely applied ordinarily, but is invoked to justify vigilante violence amid collapsed rule of law, with no discrimination protection or remedy. No trans-specific execution is documented and whether 2024 sentences were carried out is unknown, keeping this above 0.05, but the documented lethal pathway, state-absent protection, and private-violence licence place it in Severe Risk.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2024 faction courts sentenced people to death, flogging and 6 months-10 years' imprisonment for homosexuality/spreading immorality; no reversal documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No legal basis for discrimination claim or official protection documented; human-rights body demanded halt without documented effect.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Exposure varies by territory because government-controlled and faction-controlled areas apply different authorities; front lines move.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Same-sex conduct criminalised (100 lashes/up to 1 year, lesbianism up to 3 years); breach-of-modesty laws used against expression/presentation; zina provisions criminalise sex outside marriage.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No protection against sexual-orientation discrimination; constitution only guarantees rights compatible with religious law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Sexuality statute is secondary for trans visitors, but documented modesty enforcement against presentation and vigilante use makes it an operative lever if outed.

minors_guardians.interaction: No age-specific rule documented; travelling family would share the same territory-dependent presentation and detention exposures as the adult.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Statute invoked to justify civilians taking action; conservative social enforcement, concealment described as still precarious; no activist willing to speak.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No documented police protection or recourse for visibly nonconforming people.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Uneven state enforcement does not reduce risk because private violence is licensed by the same provisions.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Whether 2024 death sentences were carried out, current detainee numbers, trans-specific rules and territorial control map are not recorded.
remedies_unknowns.protection: No documented remedy, commutation or protection mechanism.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unknowns deepen uncertainty but do not offset documented death sentences and vigilante licence.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.05: lethal custody and a documented execution for trans presentation are established there; here death sentences are documented for same-sex/immorality, execution of those sentences is not recorded, and trans-specific capital application is not documented.

Similar to 0.15: criminalisation, likely imprisonment, impunity and illusory remedy. Here capital sentences were actually imposed in 2024, which is worse than 0.15's unused capital clause, but they are not documented as trans-presentation cases.
Higher than 0.35: 0.35 involves detention, fines and ineffective courts without credible lethal threat; here stoning/crucifixion sentences and vigilante violence make the worst case catastrophic.
Far below 0.65: 0.65 has equality law, brief detention, apology and compensation; here there is no protection, courts impose death, and private violence is justified by law.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: factional courts, national code, modesty enforcement and vigilante licence interact so that discovery through presentation can move from social concealment to detention, flogging, imprisonment or capital sentence with no documented remedy. Uneven ordinary enforcement lowers frequency but not severity, per rubric severity dominates. Absence of trans-specific cases and unknown execution status prevent a 0.05 rating; documented 2024 capital pattern prevents anything above Severe Risk.
